about: Exhaustive Cartesian-product subtitle-video-audio synchronization, decode-pipeline, streaming/network, content-edge-case, and playback-interaction test matrix derived from package-media/formats/material-tests.json.

video_overlay.sync_flash_box: top-right high-contrast white square flashing for 200ms at exact cue start timestamps for zero-OCR pixel detection

audio_signal.cue_beep: 1000Hz sine burst (150ms) at exact cue start timestamps
audio_signal.tts_speech: clear spoken cue phrase via macOS say when include_tts=true

op_baseline_playback.name: 基础起播与全程同步
op_baseline_playback.note: 验证起播、中段、结尾三处字幕与画面 PTS/闪烁块对齐

op_seek_stress.name: 多点前后 Seek 与非关键帧 Seek
op_seek_stress.note: 验证反复拖拽、跳回片头及落到非 I-frame 后字幕时钟能准确重同步

op_seek_mid_long_cue.name: Seek 直落长字幕正中间
op_seek_mid_long_cue.note: 验证 Seek 落到正在显示的 2s~12s 长字幕正中间时，不会出现当句漏显（PGS/VobSub/DVBSub/TS 高发 Bug）

op_speed_changes.name: 多档倍速切换并恢复 1x
op_speed_changes.note: 验证变速播放及切回常速后不产生字幕累积漂移

op_pause_resume_burst.name: 高频暂停/恢复抖动测试
op_pause_resume_burst.note: 验证多次暂停恢复不会导致音画/字幕时钟脱节

op_hot_attach_external.name: 播放中途动态挂载外挂字幕
op_hot_attach_external.note: 验证视频已播放至中段后再挂载外挂字幕时，能立即对齐当前 PTS

op_track_toggle_switch.name: 播放中途开关/切换字幕轨
op_track_toggle_switch.note: 验证关闭再开启、或多字幕轨切换后不会丢帧或错位

op_manual_delay_adjust.name: 手动字幕延迟偏移调整与归零
op_manual_delay_adjust.note: 验证手动正负延迟生效且归零后恢复精确对齐

op_loop_replay.name: 播放完毕循环重播归零
op_loop_replay.note: 验证循环重播后字幕状态机与时间轴正确复位

op_audio_track_switch.name: 多音轨实时切换同步
op_audio_track_switch.note: 验证多音轨切换时字幕时钟不漂移

op_hw_vs_sw_decode.name: 硬解 vs 软解对比校验
op_hw_vs_sw_decode.note: 对比硬件解码与软件解码下的渲染管线延迟，防止 4K60/10-bit/HDR/隔行视频硬解慢帧导致字幕提前

op_network_rebuffering.name: 弱网卡顿缓冲恢复测试
op_network_rebuffering.note: 模拟 HTTP/SMB/HLS 弱网卡顿缓冲 3 秒恢复后，验证字幕时钟不跑飞

op_audio_output_latency_250ms.name: 模拟蓝牙/AirPlay 250ms 音频输出延迟
op_audio_output_latency_250ms.note: 验证音频输出补偿 250ms 时，字幕仍锚定视频 PTS 而非被错误叠加延迟
